biggest_catch: Per-survey pay is tiny (third parties report roughly $0.25-$0.75 per survey) and invitations are not guaranteed, so reaching even the low $5 redemption bar takes sustained participation — and the official terms let Ipsos end a survey mid-way with reduced or zero points if you don't match the target profile.
catches: Survey invitations depend on your profile; Ipsos may end a survey at any stage if quotas are filled or you don't qualify, awarding reduced or no points (official T&C).
Reward type and size vary per survey difficulty and length — there is no fixed per-survey rate (official T&C).
Points are forfeited if you terminate membership without redeeming first, and accounts inactive for ~6 months may be deactivated with points forfeited (official T&C + third-party reports).
New members face a 96-hour verification hold before rewards are released from 'Pending' status (official T&C).
PayPal funds take 3-4 weeks after ordering; e-gift cards are delivered instantly to your account email (official FAQ).
Redeemed points cannot be returned, refunded, exchanged, or cancelled (official FAQ).

c1.evidence: Ipsos iSay is the panelist rewards community of Ipsos, one of the world's largest market research firms (founded 1975, ~20,000 employees, 89 countries); official FAQ and panel T&C hosted on ipsosisay.com and cdn.ipsosinteractive.com.

c2.evidence: Official FAQ 'Rewards & Redeeming Points' on ipsosisay.com describes the points program: redeem anytime via the Rewards tab, Rewards Catalogue shows available rewards and the points needed, rewards include electronic gift cards/vouchers and Ipsos Foundation donations, PayPal funds delivered within 3-4 weeks. Official T&C (Ipsos iSay Terms and Conditions) confirms points are awarded per completed survey.

c3.evidence: Membership is free; no fee to join, earn, or redeem stated in the official FAQ or T&C.

c4.evidence: Official FAQ: 'Once you've earned enough points to exchange for a reward, you can redeem them at any time by signing in to Ipsos iSay and clicking on the Rewards tab at the top of the page. Here you'll be able to browse the Rewards Catalogue to see the available rewards and the amount of points needed.'

eligibility: Free membership; registration requires email address, password, name, gender, date of birth, plus email and phone confirmation (per third-party panel guides; official T&C requires acceptance of panel terms). Available across dozens of countries.
notes: Official terms confirm a genuine points program with a published redemption process. The concrete figures most reviewers cite — 500 points ($5) minimum redemption, 1 point = $0.01, PayPal in $5/$15/$25, charity donations from 200 points — come from third-party panel guides, not the public official pages (the Rewards Catalogue with exact point costs sits behind login), so they are flagged as third-party. Catalog headline '0' corrected: iSay pays ~$0.25-$0.75 per survey in points, redeemable from about $5. App store URLs not obtained verbatim, left null rather than guessed. steps: Join Ipsos iSay for free and complete registration, confirming your email address and phone number (new accounts have a 96-hour reward verification hold).
Complete surveys when invited — points are credited per completed survey, varying with survey length and difficulty.
Sign in and open the Rewards tab to browse the Rewards Catalogue, which shows each reward and the points needed.
Select a reward (electronic gift cards/vouchers, PayPal cash, or Ipsos Foundation donation) and follow the checkout steps; the reward is sent to your account email address.
Allow up to 3-4 weeks for PayPal funds; e-gift cards arrive by email, usually instantly.
timing: Redeem anytime once enough points are earned; e-gift cards delivered instantly to your account email, PayPal funds within 3-4 weeks of ordering; 96-hour pending hold for newly registered members.
